non autē plenè manifestari. Quæstio est annō
in die illo iudicij iustificaturus sit Christ* eos
qui inhac vita crediderūt? quòd si ita sit annō

Respondeo in die illo iudicij Christus non tā

est ex operib. eorū eos in hac vita credidisse

page.notes: Marginal marks only; the text is set in roman with italic words. Some words are doubtful, notably "sumus" forms in the passage "filij Dei ... nunc sumus" and "Iustificatio, Adoptio" where the line is broken; long s has been normalised to s.
